top_signals.title: Iran sets conditions for opening Strait of Hormuz after UAE says one of its ships was targeted by airstrike
top_signals.summary: Iran's military stressed that the crucial waterway would only be reopened when the U.S. accepts Iran's conditions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Verizon mobile service down for thousands of customers in the U.S., Downdetector shows
top_signals.summary: Verizon recommended that customers who are still impacted by the outage restart their devices. The company did not provide ⁠a reason for ⁠the outage.
